name: altos_market_stats
description: Get current market snapshot for a region (e.g., "San Francisco, CA"). Returns inventory count, new listings, median price, days on market, and market action index.

date.description: Date (must be a Friday, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to most recent Friday.

res_type.description: Residential type filter: "single_family" or "multi_family". Default: single_family.

name: altos_inventory_trend
description: Track weekly inventory changes for a region (e.g., "Austin, TX"). Returns trends in inventory, new listings, days on market, median price, and price reductions.

weeks.description: Number of weeks to look back (default 12, max 52)

name: altos_active_listings
description: Search active property listings in a region (e.g., "Denver, CO"). Returns address, price, beds, baths, square footage, and listing status.

date.description: Date (must be a Friday, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to most recent Friday.

name: altos_pending_sales
description: Find properties under contract in a region (e.g., "Miami, FL"). Returns address, price, beds, baths, and days pending.

date.description: Date (must be a Friday, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to most recent Friday.

name: altos_new_listings
description: Get freshly listed properties (under one week on market) for a region (e.g., "Boston, MA"). Returns address, price, beds, baths, and listing date.

date.description: Date (must be a Friday, YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to most recent Friday.

name: altos_list_files
description: Browse downloadable regional real estate data files. Returns catalog with file names, formats, and descriptions.
